scope: Source-backed hardware and development capabilities of nine exact humanoid configurations. These profiles support labelled potential-platform matching beyond directly evidenced tasks; they do not prove deployment, autonomous task completion, suitability, orderability or German delivery.

limitations: A fixed work position still requires balance control, a safe operating area and researcher supervision.
